unknownEarlierObservation: Later original ingestion remains null; original available-record clocks retained separately
partialEvidence: Retain exact original prefixes, progress/final snapshots and interrupted bytes with explicit uncertainty
unmappedEarlierIssuerEvidence: Do not promote a later mapped sighting as original ingestion
preparedView: Research context and exclusions only; emits no primary events until policy review
requiredReview: Define whether/when verified same-day stream history can support the chosen protocol; never infer global first ingestion or rewrite V1
